title: Co’s ex-bodyguard testifies P1 billion in maletas delivered to Romualdez
summary: A former bodyguard of fugitive ex-Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co testified Thursday that some 100 suitcases containing about P1 billion were delivered to a residence of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez…

blocks.text: A former bodyguard of fugitive ex-Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co testified Thursday that some 100 suitcases containing about P1 billion were delivered to a residence of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez between 2023 and 2024.
